links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified NHS orthognathic surgery patient information leaflets
links.outcome: Readability scores (FRES, FKGL, GFI, CLI, SMOG) against NHS standards
links.effect: All three LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) significantly improved readability on all five indices (p < 0.001). Original PILs met the standard only on FKGL (6.23 ± 1.26). Gemini performed best and met targets on 3/5 indices (FRES 80.35 ± 4.31, FKGL 4.73 ± 0.79, CLI 6.77 ± 0.59). No model met all NHS standards.
links.quote: Following revision, all three LLMs significantly improved readability across all indices (p < 0.001).
